lead: A data-driven tree: expanded, selected and checked nodes are arrays of ids, and keyboard navigation follows the WAI-ARIA tree pattern (up / down, left / right, Home / End, Enter / Space).

checkable.title: Checkable
checkable.description: For permission trees and the like: checking a parent checks its available descendants, a parent is checked once all its descendants are, and a partly checked parent shows a dash.

async.title: Async loading
async.description: A `lazy` node fetches its children the first time it is expanded, with a spinner in place of the arrow meanwhile. Folders named `empty` come back empty and turn into leaves.

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: As the search term changes, only the matching nodes and their ancestors stay, expanded down to the matches, which are highlighted. With `filterMode="highlight"` every node stays.

drag.title: Drag and drop
drag.description: Drop on the top / bottom edge of a row to place the node before / after it, on the middle to put it inside (hovering over a collapsed node expands it after a moment).

lines.title: Lines
lines.description: A directory structure: connecting lines between the nodes.

block.title: Block
block.description: The background fills the whole row (antd only wraps the text by default; the other theme styles fill the row anyway).

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.root: The root (`role=tree`) and the child lists (`role=group`); `tree-group` sets the indentation of the children
styling.row: The whole row, focusable (roving tabindex); hover, the focus ring and the selected background are drawn on it
styling.parts: The expand arrow (its parent has `data-expanded` when expanded), the checkbox, the icon and the label
styling.spinner: Replaces the expand arrow while children load; the node has `data-loading` and `aria-busy`
styling.match: The matching text of a search (`<mark>`), and the text shown when nothing matches. Matching rows have `data-match`, the root has `data-filtering` while searching
styling.drag: The dragged node (`tree-item`) has `data-dragging`, as does the root during the drag; the row pointed at has `data-drop=before / after / inside`, which theme styles use to draw the drop hint
